grammar_focus: so / such / such a(n) 表示“如此……”的强调结构(so + 形容词/副词;such (a/an) + 形容词 + 名词),外加 the + 比较级, the + 比较级(the further a cat falls, the less it is hurt)与一般现在时表客观真理(承载官方KS)(原创承载 NCE3 L9 考点·城市里的猫从高楼坠落却大多幸存)
scene: 猫总能引起人们极大的兴趣。它们可以温柔亲昵,却也过着自己神秘的生活。跟狗和马不同,猫从不真正顺从,所以人们学会了尊重猫的那份独立。最让人着迷的一点,是那个古老的说法:猫有九条命。奇怪的是,这里头竟有几分真——猫能从高处坠落而幸存,是有事实根据的。不久前,一座大城市的动物医疗中心用几个月时间研究了一百多只猫,它们都有一个共同点:全都从高楼上摔下来过,可只有几只因伤死去。城市真是做这种研究的绝佳地方,因为高楼和敞开的窗台多得是。有一只叫 Sabrina 的猫,从很多层楼摔下来,却只磕断了一颗牙。“猫的举动就像训练有素的伞兵,”一位医生说。奇怪的是,猫摔得越远,反而越不容易受伤。在长距离坠落中,猫会达到很快的速度,然后有时间放松身体。它像飞鼠一样把四肢伸开——这一招极其高明,因为它增大了猫的空气阻力,落地时的冲击力也就被缓解了。

grammar_card.title: so / such 强调 + “越……越……”
grammar_card.intro: ①so 直接修饰形容词或副词:so interesting(如此有趣)、so fast(如此快)、so lucky(如此幸运)。②such 修饰名词(常带形容词):such a perfect place(单数、辅音开头用 such a)、such an amazing escape(单数、元音开头用 such an)、such interesting studies(复数或不可数用 such,不加 a/an)。一句话:so 后面跟形容词/副词,such 后面跟(形容词+)名词。③the + 比较级……,the + 比较级……=“越……越……”:The further a cat falls, the less it is hurt(猫摔得越远,越不容易受伤)。

rows: so interesting / so fast / so lucky
such a(n) + 形容词 + 单数名词
such a perfect place / such an amazing escape
such + 形容词 + 复数/不可数名词
the + 比较级, the + 比较级
The further it falls, the less it is hurt.

specialRules.rule: 判断 so 还是 such:看后面直接跟的是形容词/副词(用 so),还是名词短语(用 such)。so interesting = such an interesting study,意思一样,结构不同。
such 后接单数可数名词要加 a/an:辅音音前 such a,元音音前 such an;复数或不可数名词不加(such fun, such studies)。
美语里“公寓”说 apartment(英式 flat);“电梯”说 elevator(英式 lift)。本课已按美语写。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — How do cats try to protect themselves when falling from great heights?
options: By stretching out their legs to increase air-resistance

passage: Cats never fail to fascinate us. They can be warm and affectionate, yet they also lead mysterious lives of their own. Unlike dogs and horses, cats never become truly submissive, so people have learned to respect their feline independence. One thing that fascinates us most is the old belief that a cat has nine lives. Surprisingly, there is some real truth in it, for a cat's ability to survive a fall is based on solid facts. Not long ago, an animal medical center in a big city studied more than a hundred cats over several months. All of them had one thing in common: they had fallen from high-rise buildings, yet only a few died from their injuries. A city is such a perfect place for this kind of study, because there is no shortage of tall towers and open windowsills. One cat named Sabrina fell many storeys and suffered nothing worse than a broken tooth. 'Cats behave like well-trained paratroopers,' one doctor explained. Strangely, the further a cat falls, the less it is likely to get hurt. In a long drop, a falling cat reaches a great speed and then has time to relax. It stretches out its legs like a flying squirrel. This is so clever, because it increases the cat's air-resistance and softens the impact when it finally lands.

grammar_points.name: the + 比较级, the + 比较级(越……越……)
一般现在时表客观真理(承载官方KS)

stage5.stem: "This study of falling cats is ___ interesting!"(修饰形容词“如此”,用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 这项关于坠落猫的研究如此有趣!

stage5.stem: "The cat fell ___ fast that it had time to relax."(修饰副词“如此……以致”,用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 猫摔得如此之快,反而有时间放松身体。

stage5.stem: "The idea of nine lives is ___ strange, yet partly true."(修饰形容词“如此”,用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 九条命的说法如此奇怪,却有几分是真的。

stage5.stem: "A big city is ___ perfect place for studying falling cats."(“如此一个……的地方”,后接单数名词,用哪个)
stage5.stem_cn: 大城市是研究坠落猫的绝佳地方。

stage5.stem: "New York offers ___ interesting studies of animals."(“如此……的+复数名词”,用哪个)
stage5.stem_cn: 纽约提供了如此有趣的多项动物研究。

stage5.stem: "It was ___ amazing survival that the doctors were stunned."(“如此一次……的+元音开头名词”,用哪个)
stage5.stem_cn: 那是一次如此惊人的幸存,医生们都惊呆了。

stage5.stem: "The cat was ___ lucky to survive such a fall."(后面直接跟形容词 lucky,用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 那只猫能从这么高摔下还活着,真是太幸运了。

stage5.stem: "Sabrina had ___ a lucky escape from the fall."(后接“形容词+名词 escape”,用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: Sabrina 那次坠落逃过一劫,真够幸运。

stage5.stem: "Falling cats relax ___ well that they rarely break bones."(后面直接跟副词 well,用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 坠落的猫放松得如此之好,以致很少骨折。

stage5.stem: "The further a cat falls, ___ less it is likely to get hurt."(“越……越……”,填空处那个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 猫摔得越远,越不容易受伤。

stage5.stem: "___ faster the cat falls, the more it relaxes."(“越……越……”句首那个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 猫摔得越快,反而越放松。

stage5.stem: "___ higher the fall, the more air-resistance the cat needs."(“越……越……”句首那个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 摔得越高,猫需要的空气阻力越大。

stage5.stem: "People say a cat ___ nine lives, and it often survives great falls."(普遍说法:一般现在时)
stage5.stem_cn: 人们说猫有九条命,它常常能从高处坠落幸存。

stage5.stem: "Falling cats ___ out their legs like flying squirrels."(客观规律:一般现在时)
stage5.stem_cn: 坠落的猫像飞鼠一样把四肢伸开。

stage5.stem: "Cats are independent and never become truly ___ like dogs."(“顺从的”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 猫很独立,从不像狗那样真正顺从。

stage5.stem: "The word that means 'relating to cats' is ___."(“猫的”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 表示“猫的”那个词是 feline。

stage5.stem: "Soldiers who jump from planes with parachutes are ___."(“伞兵”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 带着降落伞从飞机上跳下的士兵是伞兵。

stage5.stem: "Spreading out its legs increases the cat's ___ and slows its fall."(“空气阻力”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 四肢张开增大了猫的空气阻力,减慢下落。
